newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Petron to shutdown 85,000-bpd crude unit in March.
newsitem.headline: Petron to shutdown 85,000-bpd crude unit in March.

text.p: Philippine refiner Petron Corp plans to shut down a 85,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) for 12 days in March for maintenance, a company official said on Wednesday.
The official said CDU No.2, the largest unit at Petron's 165,000-bpd refinery at Batangas, will be shut March 1-12.
The unit's last scheduled maintenance was in April.
Plans to debottleneck the unit to 100,000-bpd has been delayed from end of 1997 to February 1998, she said.
Other turnarounds plans include a shutdown of a 12,000-bpd thermal cracker for 20 days from mid-January.
Traders said the shutdown may prompt Petron to return to the market to buy oil products.
A Petron trader said the company has not been in the market to either buy or sell oil products as it was balanced.
